label: A7B12C_mC40_12_abcef_2i2j_d-001
title: PrMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$ Structure
comments:
The rare-earth quadruple perovskite manganites, {\em R}Mn$_{7}$O$_{12}$ undergo a variety of transformations as they cool from the high temperature \href{current_web_home_dir/A7BC12_cI40_204_bc_a_g-001}{cubic NaMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$} form. This PrMn$_{7}$O$_{12}$ structure is often the first phase transition after cooling. (Mezzadri, 2009; Okamoto, 2010; Johnson 2018; Behr, 2023). 
 (Mezzadri, 2009) found two slightly different structures for this phase depending ``on the synthesis conditions.'' We use their monoclinic (I) structure here. 
 This structure is exclusively reported in the {\em base}-centered monoclinic $I2/m$ setting of space group \#12, as this results in a conventional unit cell that is nearly cubic. AFLOW translates this into the standard {\em body}-centered monoclinic $C2/m$ setting.
